whoFor.title: Who it's for
whoFor.body: For outplacement firms, career coaches and advisors who guide knowledge workers and people with an office background, including those who arrive through a settlement agreement or a spoor 2 (return-to-work) track. Cairnly is built for office and knowledge roles: the questions and examples assume that world, so for candidates without an office background it is not the right tool yet. Cairnly doesn't replace your existing toolkit, it sits in front of it: the candidate works through the assessment as prep work and arrives at your advisor with a report to talk through.

whatYouGet.title: What your candidate gets
items: A top 3 of careers that fit, with a match score on each, plus alternatives and a few less obvious directions that still match the profile.
Per career: why it fits this person, salary ranges and an AI-impact rating from Minimal to Critical. Which direction is growing and which is shrinking, essential when retraining is on the table.
An AI coach the candidate uses to discuss the report and correct it where it is wrong. The report is not a static verdict.
A PDF report with your logo and name on it, which the candidate brings to the conversation with you.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.intro: One credit is one full assessment, including the report and the AI coach. Credits never expire. No setup fees, no certification, no contract, no minimum. When you sign up you get 3 free credits to experience what your candidate gets.
pricing.note: For comparison: consumers pay 59 euro per assessment. You decide whether you pass the credits on or absorb them into your program.

items.q: Which career assessment fits outplacement and career coaching?
items.a: Cairnly is an online career assessment for knowledge workers and people with an office background. The candidate completes it in about 45 minutes and gets a report with a top 3 of careers with match scores, alternatives, salary ranges and, for each career, an honest read on what AI will do to it. The report carries your agency's logo. An AI coach lets the candidate discuss the report and correct it where it is wrong. The real conversation stays yours.

items.q: Which candidates does Cairnly work for, and which not?
items.a: Cairnly is built for knowledge workers and people with an office background: the survey questions and the examples in the analysis are written for them. For candidates from, say, healthcare, education or production the assessment doesn't fit well right now, and we would rather not send you down a road that doesn't work for that group. There is no variant for them.

items.q: Is Cairnly a psychometric instrument or a COTAN-rated test?
items.a: No, and we don't claim it is. Cairnly is labor-market orientation: it translates someone's experience, values and preferences into concrete career directions. It sits alongside your validated instruments (COTAN-rated in the Netherlands), not in place of them.

items.q: Does Cairnly account for what someone can sustain?
items.a: Not medically, but practically. The candidate states the conditions under which work is sustainable for them: a maximum number of hours per week that counts as a hard requirement, and in a free-text field things like a calm environment, control over their own pace or little deadline pressure. Careers that clearly do not fit are pushed down the ranking. The medical judgement about capacity stays with the occupational physician and with you.

items.q: What does Cairnly cost an agency?
items.a: One credit is one full assessment including the report and the AI coach, and costs between 20 and 44 euro each excluding VAT, depending on volume. Credits never expire. There are no setup fees, no certification, no contract and no minimum. When you sign up you get 3 free credits to try it yourself.

items.q: What does it cost my candidate?
items.a: Nothing. You buy credits, the candidate redeems a code. There is no price and no paywall between your candidate and the report.

items.q: Can the report carry my own name?
items.a: Your logo and name appear on the report and on the page where your candidates start the assessment. Full white-label (your own domain, your own payment environment) is not something we offer at the moment.

items.q: What about privacy and the GDPR?
items.a: The candidate works through the assessment themselves and owns their own report. Payments run through Stripe on EU servers. Cairnly is a self-directed orientation tool that the candidate completes about themselves, not a selection instrument, and we don't supply assessments of candidates to employers.
